title: Human Resource Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with experience in core HR functions. Candidates should possess skills in HR Operations, including HR documentation, onboarding, and payroll or attendance coordination. Candidates should possess skills in Employee Relations, with the ability to address concerns, support engagement, and maintain a respectful workplace. Candidates should possess skills in HR Policies, including implementation, communication, and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements. Relevant bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage. Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in MS Office and HR software tools.

Key Skills: HR Generalist Activities,Communication Skills,HR Administration,Corporate HR,Hrsd,Administration,Corporate,Generalist Activities
